reachability.evidence: All 5 confirmed endpoints answered direct curl with no challenge, no Cloudflare, no Vercel mitigation, no clearance cookie required. Plain HTTPS GET, ~100-300ms latency, valid responses.

auth.evidence: Empty cookie jar, no Authorization header, no X-Naver-Client-Id, all endpoints returned 200 with full data.

endpoint_clusters.name: per-blog-feed
endpoint_clusters.rate_limit_observed: 1-3s between requests is safe per OSS scrapers; no 429 seen
endpoint_clusters.notes: Returns 30 posts per page with engagement metrics inline. totalCount field is unreliable (always 0); paginate until items array is empty.

endpoint_clusters.name: post-detail-mobile
endpoint_clusters.notes: Mobile URL renders post body inline; PC URL wraps in iframe (avoid). gsTagName is the only stable tag source on the mobile page.

endpoint_clusters.name: post-detail-pc-postview
endpoint_clusters.notes: Use only as a fallback when feed JSON doesn't cover the post (older posts). Larger payload (~250KB).

endpoint_clusters.name: reaction-api
endpoint_clusters.notes: 🏆 The Phase 1.7 win. Public, batchable, no headers required. Returns reactions[].count where reactionType=='like'. Eliminates Playwright fallback entirely.

endpoint_clusters.name: search-serp-mobile
endpoint_clusters.notes: 22 m.blog.naver.com URLs per page. Hashtag works via %23<tag> prefix. Pagination behavior beyond first page is unstable; defer.

warnings: Search/hashtag SERP selectors may rotate (scrapfly 2025/26 notes). Phase 3 should ship dual-selector strategy (modern + legacy) and a --debug-html flag.
Feed JSON 'totalCount' field is misleading; rely on length of 'items'.
Post titles in feed JSON ('titleWithInspectMessage') may be URL-encoded; decode before display.
PC URL (blog.naver.com/{id}/{n}) iframe-wraps body content; mobile URL does not. Always canonicalize to mobile URL for body extraction.
